modelDetails.architecture: 28 layers, 16 query and 8 key/value attention heads (GQA), 0.6B parameters (0.44B non-embedding), context length 32,768
modelDetails.description: Qwen3-0.6B is the smallest dense model of the Qwen3 series, with switchable thinking and non-thinking modes, improved reasoning, instruction following, agent capabilities and support for 100+ languages.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Reasoning in mathematics, code generation and commonsense logic; instruction following; creative writing, role-playing and multi-turn dialogue; agent tasks with external tool calling; multilingual instruction following and translation in 100+ languages

factors.software: Needs Hugging Face transformers 4.51.0 or later; can be deployed with sglang 0.4.6.post1 or later or vllm 0.8.5 or later; also supported by Ollama, LMStudio, MLX-LM, llama.cpp and KTransformers

modelCardContent.caveatsAndRecommendations: Do not use greedy decoding in thinking mode: use Temperature 0.6, TopP 0.95, TopK 20, MinP 0; in non-thinking mode use Temperature 0.7, TopP 0.8, TopK 20, MinP 0; adjust presence_penalty between 0 and 2 to reduce endless repetitions, noting that a higher value may cause language mixing; use an output length of 32,768 tokens (38,912 for complex math and programming problems); keep thinking content out of the history in multi-turn conversations; standardize the output format with the prompt when benchmarking
